receipts.zh: 菜单这一版通过了验收。短短几行口味说明，也值得在成果墙上留个位置。
receipts.en: This menu passed acceptance. A few lines about flavours deserve a place on the studio wall, too.

receipts.zh: 菜单开始返工。把需要修改的地方逐项圈出来，再慢慢打磨这一版。
receipts.en: The menu is back for rework. Mark the changes one by one and give this version another pass.

receipts.zh: 这版菜单未通过验收。先把结果记下，下一步看看还能怎样调整。
receipts.en: This menu did not pass acceptance. Record the result, then see what adjustments remain possible.

receipts.zh: 双语告示通过了验收。一张小纸，也能装下两种语言的细心。
receipts.en: The bilingual notice passed acceptance. A small sheet can hold care in two languages.

receipts.zh: 告示开始返工。两种语言需要再对一遍，尤其是容易被匆匆略过的短句。
receipts.en: The notice is back for rework. Check both languages again, especially the short lines that are easy to skim.

receipts.zh: 告示未通过验收。先收好这版，带着验收记录重新看那些句子。
receipts.en: The notice did not pass acceptance. Keep this version and revisit its sentences alongside the acceptance record.

receipts.zh: 本期网站交付通过了验收。先给这一小步留个纪念，后面的功能另有后面的工单。
receipts.en: This website phase passed acceptance. Mark this small step; later features belong to later jobs.

receipts.zh: 本期网站交付开始返工。先把眼前的问题修好，再往页面之外看。
receipts.en: This website phase is back for rework. Fix what is in front of us before looking beyond this page.

receipts.zh: 本期网站交付未通过验收。页面先留在工作台上，下一步从验收结果找起。
receipts.en: This website phase did not pass acceptance. Leave it on the workbench and let the result guide the next step.

receipts.zh: 书店系统本期通过了验收。厚厚一叠需求，这次又翻过了一页。
receipts.en: This bookshop system phase passed acceptance. Another page has turned in that thick stack of requirements.

receipts.zh: 书店系统本期开始返工。先沿着本期范围查一遍，把散开的线头重新理顺。
receipts.en: This bookshop system phase is back for rework. Walk through its scope and untangle the loose ends.

receipts.zh: 书店系统本期未通过验收。进度暂时停在这里，已做过的努力仍留在记录里。
receipts.en: This bookshop system phase did not pass acceptance. Progress pauses here; the work already done stays on record.

receipts.zh: 服务手册本期通过了验收。书页之间，多了一份认真整理过的交付。
receipts.en: This service guide phase passed acceptance. Among the pages sits another carefully prepared delivery.

receipts.zh: 服务手册本期开始返工。把不够清楚的地方摊开，再一句一句地改。
receipts.en: This service guide phase is back for rework. Lay out what is unclear and revise it sentence by sentence.

receipts.zh: 服务手册本期未通过验收。先给这页夹上书签，回头再看哪里需要说得更明白。
receipts.en: This service guide phase did not pass acceptance. Bookmark this page and revisit what needs a clearer explanation.

receipts.zh: 本期交付通过了验收。工作室又多了一件值得记住的小成果。
receipts.en: This delivery phase passed acceptance. The studio has another small achievement to remember.

receipts.zh: 本期开始返工。桌面上的草稿还没收起，接下来继续把它做好。
receipts.en: This phase is back for rework. The draft is still on the desk, ready for another pass.

receipts.zh: 本期未通过验收。这不是想要的结果，也值得如实留下一笔。
receipts.en: This phase did not pass acceptance. It is not the result we hoped for, but it still deserves an honest entry.

lines.speaker: bluewhale
lines.zh: 这张交付单里，有我们两个人实际投入的记录。
lines.en: This delivery record contains work from both of us.

lines.speaker: qwen
lines.zh: 先把这一次记清楚。下一单再看它真正需要什么。
lines.en: Let us record this one clearly, then see what the next job really needs.

lines.speaker: qwen
lines.zh: 档案里的茶会条件已经满足，现在也有空。
lines.en: The tea conditions in our profile are met, and we are available now.

lines.speaker: bluewhale
lines.zh: 那就去坐一会儿，别把下一张工单也带上茶桌。
lines.en: Then let us sit down for a moment, without bringing the next job to the tea table.

lines.speaker: bluewhale
lines.zh: 这份工单符合我们的默契条件。
lines.en: This job meets the conditions for our duo bonus.

lines.speaker: qwen
lines.zh: 收益看实际规则，配合就从眼前这一期开始。
lines.en: The rules determine the benefit. Let us focus on this phase together.

lines.speaker: mistral
lines.zh: 这次交付记录里，也有我们搭档的那一份。
lines.en: The delivery record includes contributions from both of us.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.zh: 留下证据就好，不必把所有功劳都揽过来。
lines.en: Keeping the evidence is enough; we need not claim all the credit.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.zh: 档案的条件够了，现在也没有占用冲突。
lines.en: The profile conditions are met, with no current availability conflict.

lines.speaker: mistral
lines.zh: 好，先喝茶。速度最快的那条路，也要留个休息口。
lines.en: Good, tea first. Even the fastest route needs a place to rest.

lines.speaker: mistral
lines.zh: 这次部署满足我们的搭档条件。
lines.en: This deployment meets our duo conditions.

lines.speaker: llama
lines.zh: 模式选对了，才谈得上这份收益。
lines.en: The deployment mode has to fit before that benefit applies.

neutral.zh: 先把这次的记录收好，细节留待核对。
neutral.en: Keep this record for now; the details can be checked later.

reviewed.zh: 本期记录中包含实际审查投入。
reviewed.en: This phase includes recorded review work.

duoInactive.zh: 默契已经解锁，但当前工单不符合生效条件。
duoInactive.en: The duo is unlocked, but this job does not meet its activation conditions.
